name: signageOS
description: Integrates Drupal's Digital Signage Framework with the signageOS device platform.
project_description:
This module provides an implementation for the Digital Signage Provider signageOS and depends on the Digital Signage Framework .

 signageOS is the world-leading digital signage integration & device management platform and integrates into device from Samsung, LG, Philips, BrightSign, NEC, Panasonic, Sharp, BenQ, Android and others . They support a huge list of features across all these devices.

 By integrating signageOS into Drupal Digital Signage Framework, the most important platform features are accessible directly from within your Drupal site. That way, you have direct access to your devices connected to the signageOS platform, you publish content and schedules and monitor the devices and their status without even leaving your CMS.

 This integration is developed and maintained by bitegra Solutions , an official signageOS partner . If you want to give it a trial, please contact us at https://www.bitegra-solutions.de/en/contact and we'll provide you with the details. In the near future, we're planning to provide the sign-up for the signageOS account directly inside of Drupal through.
